subject: Data retainability affidavit & log sampling request
messages:
From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@datacontrol.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@datacontrol.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request to preserve tenant debug traces + affidavit template

Hi Aditya,

Quick note from our security & compliance team — we're in the middle of a third-party audit that requires a longer window for a scoped set of debug traces. Our standard contract references a 30-day ephemeral retention for debug/session traces; for this audit we need preservation of a narrow subset for 180 days (tenant: dc-prod-12, keys: session_id prefix "dc-usr-").

Can Redwood: 1) confirm you can produce a customer-signed retainability affidavit that shows logs were preserved and exported on request, 2) provide a sampling manifest (CSV) showing the exact objects retained, and 3) advise whether you require a DPA addendum or PO to proceed?

We're also compiling SIG/CAIQ evidence and would like to reference the affidavit in our submission. If you have a standard affidavit template for retention exceptions (SOC 2 / SIG friendly) please attach.

We can be flexible on timing but would like a plan and ETA within 72 hours so our audit timeline doesn't slip.

Thanks —
Nina Patel
Head of Security Operations
DataControl Inc.

Attachments: none

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@datacontrol.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Nov 2025 10:03:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to preserve tenant debug traces + affidavit template

Nina — thanks for the clear ask. We're able to support a scoped 180-day preservation for the objects you specified provided we have a signed attestation and the export manifests you want captured. Proposed next steps (short mutual action plan):

- We prepare a retainability affidavit template that includes: scope (tenant id, key prefixes), retention window, method of preservation (snapshot vs immutable export), and a manifest hash.
- You confirm the exact object prefixes and any time-range constraints (e.g., only Nov 1–Nov 30 traces).
- Legal: confirm whether a DPA addendum or an MSA amendment is needed; if so please share the contact and PO/DocuSign flow.
- We generate a sampling manifest (CSV) and a signed evidence packet once retention is in place.

Ben and Marissa looped — Ben will own the evidence pack, Marissa will coordinate delivery to your HubSpot/legal contact. We can put together an initial checklist (attached) and kick off a 30-min call tomorrow if that helps.

Estimate: affidavit template + checklist in 24 hours; sampling manifest within 48 hours after you confirm scope.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Lead — Redwood Inference

Attachments: initial-evidence-checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@datacontrol.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Nov 2025 11:20:45 -0800
Subject: FW: Request to preserve tenant debug traces + affidavit template

Nina — forwarding our internal plan and what you'll receive.

On scope: we will target the exact tenant (dc-prod-12) and the session_id prefix you provided. We'll produce:
- sampling_manifest.csv: row-per-object (object_key, timestamp, size_bytes, retention_tag)
- retainability_affidavit.pdf: signed by our compliance lead, describing preservation method and timeframe, with a SHA256 of the manifest attached
- delivery options: 1) secure Drive link with signed manifest + zip of exported traces, or 2) hand-off via an SFTP export token (temporary credentials) if you prefer inbound transfer to your environment.

A couple of compliance notes for your legal team:
- For SOC 2 / SIG evidence sets we include the affidavit as a signed artifact but it is not a contract modification. If legal requires contractual standing (DPA addendum), we'll need a quick DocuSign routing before we release exported data.
- We call out what we term "retention attenuation" in the affidavit (i.e., that it's a customer-scoped exception limited to listed keys, not a platform-wide policy change).

Attached is the sampling plan CSV stub. If you approve the format, we will run the manifest export and return the completed CSV with SHA256.

Next action: Nina, please reply with either (A) accepted format and preferred delivery mechanism, or (B) attach the DPA addendum if you want contractual coverage before export. We'll wait on (A)/(B) before exporting.

Ben Carter
Principal, Security Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: sampling_manifest.csv (stub)

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@datacontrol.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@datacontrol.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 06 Nov 2025 17:35:09 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to preserve tenant debug traces + affidavit template

Thanks — format looks good and Legal is fine with Redwood providing the evidence packet as an artifact (they do not require an MSA amendment for this scope). We have attached a signed retainability affidavit (signed by our CISO) to this reply.

Deliverables requested:
- Completed sampling_manifest.csv with SHA256 hash
- Signed retainability_affidavit.pdf (we attached our signed copy for your records)
- Secure Drive link to the exported zip (encrypted)

Please proceed with the export and send the Drive link when ready. If you need a PO for cost recovery for the export operation, let us know — otherwise we'll proceed under the existing support engagement.

Nina Patel
Head of Security Operations
DataControl Inc.

Attachments: retainability_affidavit_signed.pdf
